# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part B3 (Slot 67=heg): 12-Major AI Strategic Ecology & Dynamic Anti-Hegemon Layer (oe_mai_ / oe_heg_ai_). Generated by gen_majors_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# O(1) calendar month clock (1337.4 = 0) for Slot 67 monthly deduplication.
oe_heg_ai_m_now = {
    value = current_year
    subtract = 1337
    multiply = 12
    add = current_month
    subtract = 4
}

# Country scope: Hegemon candidate score (num_locations + 80 bonus for restored Roman 6+/4+ theaters).
oe_heg_ai_cand_score = {
    value = num_locations
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                tag = BYZ
                tag = ROM
            }
            has_variable = oe_rr_count
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_count }
                OR = {
                    var:oe_rr_count >= 6
                    AND = {
                        oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes
                        var:oe_rr_count >= 4
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        add = 80
    }
}

# Country scope: > 0 iff this candidate beats global_var:oe_heg_ai_best_score.
oe_heg_ai_cand_score_diff = {
    value = oe_heg_ai_cand_score
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_best_score }
        subtract = global_var:oe_heg_ai_best_score
    }
}
